title: This place where I’m working the night reminds me of a dream I had a while back
content: Except in the dream it was multiple stories, and the halls were nonsensical, connecting in impossible ways, and with many staircases to nowhere. Also in the dream I was being chased by something, and I set the place on fire. Reality is the place is empty aside from sleeping people and the occasional other night worker, I’m not being chased, and I don’t have plans to set anything on fire.
